subject: Re: Looking forward to speaking
text:
Hi Tom,

Thanks for asking.

Looking forward to connecting as per your availability soon. The objective
of our discussion is to explore a potential collaboration between Encord
and Jupiter AI Labs regarding Physical AI, Robotics, and multimodal data
workflows.

Jupiter AI Labs is expanding as a robotics data collection and managed
operations partner. We are currently building capabilities around:

• Egocentric first-person data collection (head-mounted + wrist cameras)
• Multi-view robotics datasets
• Human demonstration data for robot learning
• Industrial workflows (assembly, maintenance, tools, warehouse,
automotive/service operations)
• IMU-based motion capture and sensorized data collection
• Data QA, annotation, and evaluation pipelines

We would like to understand:

   1.

   Opportunities to become a data collection, annotation, or managed
   workforce partner for Encord
   2.

   Upcoming requirements around VLA models, robotics foundation models,
   video understanding, and multimodal AI
   3.

   We can also share our current infrastructure, sample datasets, and
   scaling capability during the call.

Presentation:
https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/199pw--ZtcwV3rGuhwUlbxjU6oll5VT4A/edit?slide=id.p1#slide=id.p1

subject: agent data quality
text:
Hey Laura  

 Let’s do Wednesday 2 June, 2pm SGT? 

 On Tue, 2 Jun 2026 at 07:49, Laura Zhu < 
laura.zhu@encord.com> wrote: 

Hi Denise,

Virtuals Protocol’s agent commerce model only works if the underlying multimodal data stays clean: prompts, transcripts, images, and any generated assets all need consistent review and traceability as you iterate.

Encord is the data layer teams use to curate and evaluate unstructured datasets so model changes are driven by the right slices of data, not guesswork. That usually means faster iteration and fewer regressions when new modalities or edge cases show up.

Can we set up 20 minutes this week?
